messages.subject: memory issues
messages.body_plain:
Dear breedRs,

In the last major refactoring of breedR (v. 0.10) I introduced inadvertedly some memory-intensive operations, that were more evident in models with an Autoregressive spatial component.

This problem was raised by Jan Kowalczyk during our last breedR training workshop, and properly reported <https://github.com/famuvie/breedR/issues/37> at GitHub.

I have just commited the patch 9 <https://github.com/famuvie/breedR/commit/c31f339bfb86b52ae0836bb4a66ecf22bf30eb19> of version 0.10 that fixes this problem.

Make sure you update before running moderate AR models.

ƒacu.-
